title: For-Sale-by-Owner Platforms and Intermediation Pricing: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
eligible_reason: Two-city, single-date design. Treatment = listing in Hangzhou (where the government FSBO platform launched) and After = listed on or after August 19, 2021; Suzhou is the control city. felm(log(PricePerSquareMeter) ~ Treatment:After | NeighborhoodID + ListingDate | 0 | NeighborhoodID) plus versions with listing characteristics; sales success, days on market and transaction price columns add listing controls; event study interacts Treatment with listing months. One treated city and one adoption date, so not staggered.
design_notes: R (lfe::felm). Replication Code/ReplicationCode_Housing.R on ListingPrice.csv, SalesSuccess.csv, SalesOutcomes.csv (listing-level repeated cross-sections). Balance checks regress listing characteristics on After within each city.
data_provenance_note: README: 'The data file contains a random 20% sample'; IDs anonymized.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). One treated city, one date.
